item.title: September 11 – October 10, 2026 Exhibitions
item.description:
Friday, September 11, 2026 at 6 PM

Location: Box 13 ArtSpace, 6700 Harrisburg Blvd., Houston, TX, 77011, United States

BOX 13 ArtSpace is pleased to present four new exhibitions opening Friday, September 11 , 2026 6–9 PM. BOX 13 ArtSpace is pleased to present in the Front BOX gallery: “Cryptic Bodies,” an exhibition of four interdisciplinary Houston-based femme artists who work in sculpture, collage, zines, and socially engaged practices. As one excavates their layered work, bodies are revealed, both human, non-human, touching upon women’s health, fragmentary memories, and interconnected ecosystems and identities. The exhibit in the Back gallery features Chris Ireland’s “Dead Letter Office,” which explores home, memory, and placelessness through carefully constructed collages that combine fragments from lived experience, online archives, real estate listings, and personal photographs. For “Mother Earth Weaves Infinite” in the Box 13 Window BOX Gallery, Cathie Kayser and Ellen H Ray use a variety of materials and techniques, including fabrics, mulberry silks, soft sculpture, paper mache, and wire and paper sculptures to present an immersive experience that highlights the complexity of the mycorrhizal network. With this work, the artists invite viewers to consider the interconnectedness of all living systems. The Earth, and the universe encompassing it, is a master plan of intelligent design that holds lessons for us about systems that work. Moving to our Upstairs BOX gallery we are excited to introduce “Grip Strength: An Army of Lovers Shall Not Fail” by KT Abadir-Mullally. Through interactive soft sculptures and ceramics inspired by strength sports and queer activism, the exhibition invites visitors to engage with themes of queer resilience, desire, collective power, and resistance. The exhibitions continue through October 10, 2026. An Opening Reception will be held on Friday, September 11, 2026, 6–9 PM at BOX 13 ArtSpace, 6700 Harrisburg, Houston, TX 77011. This event is funded in part by the City of Houston through the Houston Arts Alliance and Houston MOCA. Additional support is provided by The Brown Foundation, Saint Arnold Brewing Company, Giant Texas Distillers, JP Morgan – Nancy O’Connor Fund, and all who help make our programming possible.

item.title: Unified Topgolf Pro-Am (Houston-Katy)
item.description:
Friday, September 18, 2026 at 10 AM

Location: Topgolf-Katy, 1030 Memorial Brook Blvd, Houston, TX 77084, Houston, 77084

The Unified Topgolf Pro-Am is one of the most exciting and meaningful community partnership events hosted by Special Olympics Texas, bringing together athletes, families, coaches, volunteers, corporate partners, and local business leaders for an unforgettable day of golf, laughter, connection, and community impact. Each bay includes a Special Olympics Texas athlete paired alongside five golfers, creating a truly unique experience where relationships, memories, and meaningful moments are built throughout the day. From friendly competition and team spirit to incredible conversations and shared experiences, the event is designed to bring people together in a fun and welcoming environment while directly supporting local athletes and programs. Proceeds from the Unified Topgolf Pro-Am help provide year-round sports training, competitions, health initiatives, leadership development, and educational opportunities for children, teenagers, and adults with intellectual disabilities throughout the greater Houston area. As the event continues growing each year, the Unified Topgolf Pro-Am has quickly become a tremendous opportunity for organizations and community members to make a real impact while being part of something incredibly energetic, uplifting, and memorable. For more information regarding sponsorship opportunities, team entries, volunteer involvement, or sponsorship opportunities, please reach out to Jared Kossover, Strategic Partnerships Manager with Special Olympics Texas Jared Kossover E: jkossover@sotx.org C: 737-867-9659

The exhibit in the Back gallery features Chris Ireland’s “Dead Letter Office,” which explores home, memory, and placelessness through carefully constructed collages that combine fragments from lived experience, online archives, real estate listings, and personal photographs. For “Mother Earth Weaves Infinite” in the Box 13 Window BOX Gallery, Cathie Kayser and Ellen H Ray use a variety of materials and techniques, including fabrics, mulberry silks, soft sculpture, paper mache, and wire and paper sculptures to present an immersive experience that highlights the complexity of the mycorrhizal network. With this work, the artists invite viewers to consider the interconnectedness of all living systems. The Earth, and the universe encompassing it, is a master plan of intelligent design that holds lessons for us about systems that work. Moving to our Upstairs BOX gallery we are excited to introduce “Grip Strength: An Army of Lovers Shall Not Fail” by KT Abadir-Mullally. Through interactive soft sculptures and ceramics inspired by strength sports and queer activism, the exhibition invites visitors to engage with themes of queer resilience, desire, collective power, and resistance. The exhibitions continue through October 10, 2026. An Opening Reception will be held on Friday, September 11, 2026, 6–9 PM at BOX 13 ArtSpace, 6700 Harrisburg, Houston, TX 77011. This event is funded in part by the City of Houston through the Houston Arts Alliance and Houston MOCA. Additional support is provided by The Brown Foundation, Saint Arnold Brewing Company, Giant Texas Distillers, JP Morgan – Nancy O’Connor Fund, and all who help make our programming possible.
